name: EPA AP-42 emission factors
notes: AP-42 (since 1972): EPA's primary compilation of air-emission factors for 200+ stationary source categories (petroleum industry, storage tanks, combustion) - open chapters and PDFs. The separate GHGRP (Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program) facility data is also open on epa.gov. Evidence: epa.gov AP-42 page read 2026-10-29.
